tha-ap474:4.1: naddasaṁ → nāddasaṁ (bj, pts) | vicinaṁ naddasaṁ → vijanaṁ addasaṁ (sya-all) | nāddasaṁ → naddasaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap474:10.4: mamaṁ chaḷasītisahassāni → mama chaḷāsītisahassāni (sya-all) | mamaṁ chaḷasītisahassāni nāriyo → mama chalāsītisahassāni nariyo (pts)
tha-ap474:11.3: vicittavatthābharaṇā āmukkamaṇikuṇḍalā aḷārapamhā → vacittavatthābharaṇā āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā āḷāramukhā (sya-all)
tha-ap474:11.4: āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā → āmukkamaṇikuṇḍalā (bj: machasaṁ) | āmukkamaṇikuṇḍalā → āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā (cck: sī. syā. pī.)
tha-ap474:13.4: piḷandhanā → pilandhanā (sya-all) | yadicchāya → yadicchanti (bj: machasaṁ) | yadicchasi → yadicchāya (cck: sī. pī.)
tha-ap474:16.3: pamuttomhi → sumuttomhi (sya-all) | pamuttomhi pattomhi → pamutto mhi patto ca (pts)
tha-ap474:17.3: divasañceva rattiñca → samantā sattaratanā (bj, pts) | sattaratanā → divasañceca rattiñca (bj: machasaṁ) | rattiñca → samantā sattaratanā (cck: sī. pī. ka.)
